run_rm_pt_delete_checkpoints: run rm_pt.py to recursively delete old checkpoint .pt files from training directories
run_rm_pt_save_last_n: run rm_pt.py with --save-last to keep the N most recent checkpoint files
run_rm_pt_save_every_n: run rm_pt.py with --save-every to keep every Nth checkpoint file
run_rm_pt_delete_best_last: run rm_pt.py with --delete-best and --delete-last to remove special checkpoint files
run_rm_pt_dereference_symlinks: run rm_pt.py to dereference symlinks and preserve checkpoint files as real copies
